messages:
meera: opened PR to add Acadia-13B int8 model card and catalog entry. includes limits table, benchmark summary, migration notes, and SDK snippets. preview: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4901
oliver: awesome — can you paste the bench numbers you used for the limits table and the hardware used?
sam: quick heads up: make sure the compatibility row mentions runtime behavior for 3.0 vs 3.1+ (we had issues with KV layout last time).
kevin: bench details: ran on a100-sxm4 (1x), sequences 512, batch=4 -> p50 gen latency ~38ms; throughput (sustained, batch=8) ~160 tok/s; memory resident ~40GB with Q4 int8. full bench csv: https://gist.github.com/kevin/bencsv5678
mahmoud: link-checker caught a broken relative link in migration section: `../../models/acadia/index.md` -> 404. switch to canonical `/models/acadia` or use doc slug helper.
docs-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/acadia -> 404
meera: thanks — I'll change to `/models/acadia` and add a redirect note in the PR so old links keep working.
oliver: suggestion for wording on runtime compatibility: short table row: `Runtime < 3.1: int8 blobs not supported (KV v2). Requests will fall back to Acadia-13B-fp16; upgrade runtime to use int8.` keep it explicit.
sam: also add a note under "behavior diffs" about small tokenization parity differences and occasional output variance when switching between fp16 and int8. helps set expectations for regression tests.
kevin: nit: in the limits table list `max sequence: 8192 (tested), recommended sustained <=4096 for low P50` — call out that the 8192 runs were with longer padding and saw throughput drop ~2x.
mahmoud: adding SDK snippets for embeddings + batched inference. dropping raw snippets here for the PR:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region='us-west')
texts = ["alpha", "bravo", "charlie"]
emb = client.embeddings.create(model="acadia-13b-int8", input=texts, batch_size=6)
print([d.embedding for d in emb.data])
```
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'us-west' })
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'acadia-13b-int8', input: ['a','b','c'], batchSize: 6 })
console.log(resp.data.map(d => d.embedding))
```
meera: great, I'll paste those in. will also add an examples section showing how to opt out of int8: `model: 'acadia-13b-fp16'` for users who need deterministic parity.
oliver: please also add a short note in the model-card: `quantization: int8 (Q4) — performance/quality tradeoffs described below` instead of generic "quantized" wording.
sam: LGTM, will review the PR tomorrow morning.
kevin: one more small ask: add a tiny benchmark note about token type/encoding — we saw ~5% variance when using utf-8 vs bytes input, might save support ping time later.
docs-bot: PR updated, running checks (link-check, lint, build)
deploy-bot: docs build succeeded — staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/models/acadia (expires in 48h)
meera: thanks all — merging after sam's review. I'll follow up with a short announcement in #release-war-room once the card is live.
